name: Brainstorm (how)
description: Planner that seeds the distinct production approaches to explore (default 3) from the brief + the winning concept + the capability registry, fanned out into parallel how-idea agents.
produce: Read the brief, the winning concept (with its emphasis vector), and the production-capability registry, then seed the distinct production approaches to explore in parallel (default 3). Each approach is a genuinely different way to MAKE the winning concept over the universal spine. Output the generic approach list the engine fans out into how-idea agents.
